<div class="wv-epigraph">{{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|"Is there anything we can do for her?" Mercy asked, sounding worried.}}<div class="wv-epigraph-cite">{{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|— ''Skysworn'', chapter 17}}</div></div>
''See also: [[Mercy Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Akura Mercy]] is the daughter of the [[Monarch]], [[Malice]], and a member of her clan. Though she has experienced exile from her family, she remains a significant figure who serves as a representative for them, often acting as a source of reassurance and listening to others. She is characterized by her kindness and desire to do better than the undignified or cruel behavior seen in others. Mercy is a [[Skysworn]] and a [[Reaper]] who carries various medicinal supplies, including [[elixirs]] and herbs. She utilizes a staff made of twisted [[black madra]] named [[Suu]], which can transform into a bow. Her powerful arsenal includes the [[The Book of Eternal Night|Book of Eternal Night]], from which she draws techniques, and the [[Eclipse]], an [[ancient bow]]. As a person of high standing, she possesses an office in a tower and has access to significant resources, such as mountains of living metals intended to help people live lives of plenty. Despite her high status and the immense power she wields, she strives to find her own identity apart from her mother.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Mercy is a girl with purple eyes and hair made of living [[Shadow|shadow]] wisps that float like gas or drifting [[water]]. She has worn various outfits, including black-and-white [[sacred artist's robe|sacred artist's robes]] with a smooth purple breastplate, green [[Skysworn]] plate armor, and black armor. At times, her skin has appeared red and burned, or she has been seen with amethyst crystalline armor covering her limbs.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Known to be nice to everyone, Mercy is a concerned and protective individual who has expressed worry for [[Yerin]] and [[Lindon]]. She is an exile from the [[Akura clan]] who refused to return home to avoid becoming a Lady, and she has struggled with the memory of her mother's punishments. Despite her grief and fear, she acts as a guide and teammate, often urging others to move forward.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Mercy is the grand-niece of [[Akura Charity]] and the daughter of [[Uncle Fury]] and a [[Sage]]. She is the sister of [[Akura Pride|Pride]] and inherited her weapon, [[Suu]], from her [[Monarch]] mother. Her mastery of the [[Shadow’s Edge]] was returned to her by [[Akura Malice]], who also treated her poorly and punished her in front of the clan. Mercy is an ally to [[Lindon]], [[Yerin]], [[Eithan]], and [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]], and she has fought against [[Sopharanatoth|Sophara]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Mercy is an [[Abidan]] and a member of the [[Reaper Division]] who utilizes [[shadow madra]], [[soulfire]], and the [[Puppeteer's Iron body]]. She wields various weapons including the [[dragon]]-headed staff [[Suu]], the bow [[Eclipse]], and the bow [[Shattersight]], often firing violet or black star-shaped arrows. Her techniques include [[Strings of Shadow]], [[Nightworm Venom]], [[Shadow]]'s Edge, and the ability to manifest [[bloodline armor]].}}

== History ==
=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|Akura clan member}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|As a member of the [[Akura clan]], Mercy participated in the course by straddling a staff topped with a [[dragon]]'s head.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c15">''Skysworn'', chapter 15</ref><ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c17">''Skysworn'', chapter 17</ref> She utilizes a staff and wields [[black madra]] that coats both her palms and the weapon.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c16">''Skysworn'', chapter 16</ref> During a terrifying encounter, she stood below a door holding her staff with both hands to provide protection.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c16" /> The girl used a vast black web and her [[Blood Shadow]] to intercept and hold back the [[Bloodspawn|bloodspawn]] on the stairs for a short time.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c16" /><ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c17" /> While expressing fear, she pushed [[Lindon]] deeper into a structure and showed concern for [[Yerin]].<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c17" /> Mercy was present for the conversation between [[Lindon]] and [[Eithan]], where she watched as [[Yerin]] and [[Lindon]] sat motionless while staring into space.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c18">''Skysworn'', chapter 18</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|Uncrowned King tournament}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|Mercy, the niece of [[Aunt Charity]], is set to lead a team during the [[Uncrowned King Tournament|Uncrowned King tournament]].<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c20" /> While fighting the second prince, she sensed [[Lindon]] advancing to the rank of [[Underlord]].<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c20" /><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c21">''Underlord'', chapter 21</ref> Having previously been a [[Truegold]], she has now achieved a stable [[advancement]] to [[Underlady]].<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c21" /> She originally left her home to avoid becoming a Lady and wears a [[veil]] from her mother.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c21" /> After rolling [[Suu]] between her hands and pointing to a [[silver-and-purple owl]] on the ceiling, Mercy is gone.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c21" /><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c22">''Underlord'', chapter 22</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|The daughter of the [[Monarch]], Mercy is the sister of [[Akura Pride]] and possesses both the [[The Book of Eternal Night|Book of Eternal Night]] and [[Eclipse]], the [[Ancient Bow of the Soulseeker]].<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c3">''Uncrowned'', chapter 3</ref><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c6">''Uncrowned'', chapter 6</ref> A preferred candidate for the [[Uncrowned]], she is a [[Copper]] who earned a perfect score on her training program within three days, achieving this [[advancement]] just hours before [[Lindon]].<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c4">''Uncrowned'', chapter 4</ref> While located on the sixth island, she utilizes a staff of twisted [[black madra]] called [[Suu]] and employs [[Striker techniques]] to seal or destroy enemies.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c7">''Uncrowned'', chapter 7</ref><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c9">''Uncrowned'', chapter 9</ref><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c11">''Uncrowned'', chapter 11</ref> Her abilities include [[bloodline armor]], a [[Dream of Darkness]] [[technique]], and the use of [[Strings of Shadow]] to bind her foes.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c12">''Uncrowned'', chapter 12</ref><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c14">''Uncrowned'', chapter 14</ref> During the [[tournament]], she ranked eighth and demonstrated her capability to conjure arrows for defense.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c12" /><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c14" /> As an entity that accompanies [[Lindon]], she has been seen tending to [[Naru Saeya]] and watching fights with excitement in her eyes.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c13">''Uncrowned'', chapter 13</ref><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c14" />}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Tournament competitor}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|As a competitor in the [[tournament]], Mercy aims to defeat [[Sopharanatoth|Sophara]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c5">''Wintersteel'', chapter 5</ref> While watching the [[Uncrowned]] matches with [[Lindon]] and [[Yerin]], it is noted that her signature would resemble [[Eithan]]'s because of [[Akura Malice]]'s [[shadow madra]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c6">''Wintersteel'', chapter 6</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c7">''Wintersteel'', chapter 7</ref> During the [[Uncrowned ceremony]], [[Charity]] floated behind her, and Mercy later gathered with [[Yerin]] and [[Eithan]] at the end of the [[cloudship]] dock before leaving the scene.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c7" /><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c8">''Wintersteel'', chapter 8</ref> One of her tricks assisted [[Lindon]] in discovering his [[Underlord revelation]], and she previously trained on the [[Phantom Islands]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c8" /> Mercy has a brother and cannot allow for any distractions until she reaches the peak of [[Archlord]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c14">''Wintersteel'', chapter 14</ref> After [[Charity]] intends to relay [[Lindon]]'s greetings, Mercy is transported to the tunnels beneath the stadium by [[Aunt Charity]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c14" /><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c16">''Wintersteel'', chapter 16</ref> An [[Underlady]] with [[Overlord-level madra]], Mercy utilizes the [[Dark Tide Incantation]], [[Nightworm Venom]], [[Shadow’s Edge]], [[Strings of Shadow]], [[soulfire]], [[bloodline armor]], and the [[Moon’s Eye]], even achieving a temporary [[advancement]] to [[Overlady]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c16" /> Following three fights where [[Charity]] and [[Fury]] were being considerate of her, Mercy expressed belief that [[Lindon]] could win.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c17">''Wintersteel'', chapter 17</ref> While present in the waiting room cheering for [[Yerin]], she felt nervous that [[Aunt Charity]] could not transport them to [[Sky's Edge]] alone and reacted to a projection of [[Lindon]]'s face.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c18">''Wintersteel'', chapter 18</ref> Finally, Mercy used a bow to fire a volley of violet arrows.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c19">''Wintersteel'', chapter 19</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|While riding [[Suu]], Mercy carries healing salve or pills and finds herself in a dangerous situation.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c19" /><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c21">''Wintersteel'', chapter 21</ref> She is someone [[Malice]] would [[sacrifice]] for her family and possesses the ability to relay requests to [[Fury]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c22">''Wintersteel'', chapter 22</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c23">''Wintersteel'', chapter 23</ref> Mercy was present with [[Lindon]] and [[Fury]], and she remained at [[Lindon]]'s bedside when he woke up.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c23" /><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c25">''Wintersteel'', chapter 25</ref> After agreeing that [[Lindon]] did the right thing, she fought [[Sopharanatoth|Sophara]], who had previously used [[Azure Moon Reigns]] against her.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c25" /> Mentioned in relation to [[Malice]]'s plans, Mercy was seen arguing with [[Akura Pride|Pride]] near the [[evacuation portal]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c26">''Wintersteel'', chapter 26</ref> As a member of [[Lindon]]'s team whom [[Lindon]] can feel, she was fully armored and released a volley of violet arrows from her [[Archlord bow]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c27">''Wintersteel'', chapter 27</ref> With wild, grieving eyes, Mercy was ambushed by the [[Sage of Red Faith]] and several others sent by [[Reigan Shen]] to kill her and [[Akura Pride|Pride]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c27" /> Following an assassination attempt by [[Sopharanatoth|Sophara]], Mercy found that her demands within the [[Akura clan]] were fulfilled.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c28">''Wintersteel'', chapter 28</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|Evacuation efforts}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|During the evacuation efforts, Mercy traveled to visit various clans in person and utilized a [[communication construct]].<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c12">''Bloodline'', chapter 12</ref><ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c13">''Bloodline'', chapter 13</ref> Although she was initially too far away to escape in time, leaving [[Lindon]] uncertain of her status, Mercy eventually flew in unharmed while bobbing on her staff.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c13" /><ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c15">''Bloodline'', chapter 15</ref><ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c16">''Bloodline'', chapter 16</ref> After burying an object that felt like a scripted tool in the ground, she became a person whom [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]] could potentially reach to escape.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c16" /><ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c17">''Bloodline'', chapter 17</ref> Mercy laid a hand on [[Lindon]]'s shoulder and provided an endorsement for his family in [[Moongrave]].<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c17" /><ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c18">''Bloodline'', chapter 18</ref> While she possesses a [[void key]] and is someone [[Lindon]] marries in some possible futures, she also tossed him a [[scripted stone]].<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c18" /> After stumbling out of a [[spatial crack]], Mercy herded a crowd of [[Irons]] to the south.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c19">''Bloodline'', chapter 19</ref> She intended to return to [[Sacred Valley]] once time unfroze after putting [[Jai Chen]] in charge, even instructing the [[sacred artists]] to listen to him.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c19" /><ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c21">''Bloodline'', chapter 21</ref> Mercy's armor had been shattered by the [[Dreadgod]].<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c20">''Bloodline'', chapter 20</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|Labyrinth exploration}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|While exploring [[labyrinth|the labyrinth]], Mercy was located in the northwest and expressed that there was no time to waste.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c9">''Reaper'', chapter 9</ref><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c10">''Reaper'', chapter 10</ref> Concerned by the speed of their progress, she urged the group to move forward and utilized [[Strings of Shadow]] to pull herself up.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c11">''Reaper'', chapter 11</ref> After appearing like a rat partially drowned in mud, she worked with [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]] to create a green-and-black barrier before [[Eithan]] ordered her to use the [[Dream of Darkness]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c14">''Reaper'', chapter 14</ref> Having once felt like an [[Overlady]], Mercy utilized amethyst bolts and [[soulfire]]-enhanced [[Strings of Shadow]] to focus her attacks on [[Reigan Shen]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c16">''Reaper'', chapter 16</ref> As she fell, she summoned her [[bloodline armor]], but she was later found using a healing [[construct]] on her neck while contained within a cocoon of [[Strings of Shadow]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c16" /><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c17">''Reaper'', chapter 17</ref> Although [[Lindon]] and his companions intended to help her advance, [[Yerin]] picked up Mercy, whose [[madra]] reserves were low and channels strained from the [[destruction]] of her armor.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c17" /><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c18">''Reaper'', chapter 18</ref> Mercy is a peak [[Underlady]] who is acclimated to [[Overlord-level madra]] and [[soulfire]] due to her Book, and she was seen [[cycling]] in the hallway while holding her bow, [[Suu]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c18" /><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c19">''Reaper'', chapter 19</ref> She used armor to cover her limbs and escaped for the same reason [[Lindon]] was forced to leave [[Orthos]], at one point holding both [[Orthos]] and [[Little Blue]] before trembling at [[Malice]]'s feet.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c20">''Reaper'', chapter 20</ref><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c23">''Reaper'', === {{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Moongrave}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Currently located in [[Moongrave]], [[Akura Mercy]] is a Book possessor who assisted [[Lindon]] with his [[Overlord revelation]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c3">''Dreadgod'', chapter 3</ref><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c8">''Dreadgod'', chapter 8</ref> As a representative of her family, she is one of six beings threatened by the [[Silent King]] and was even named by the [[Dreadgod]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c4">''Dreadgod'', chapter 4</ref><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c5">''Dreadgod'', chapter 5</ref><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c8" /> Despite her mother forbidding her from joining [[Lindon]] and [[Dross]], Mercy has previously fought the [[Wandering Titan]] by pushing her [[bloodline armor]] to its limits.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c5" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c6">''Dreadgod'', chapter 6</ref> She maintains an office at the top of a tower and has accessed restricted [[library]] records, possessing knowledge regarding the location of certain plans.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c8" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c10">''Dreadgod'', chapter 10</ref><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c12">''Dreadgod'', chapter 12</ref> While waiting in a short tower, she informed [[Lindon]] that the defenses of [[Moongrave]] consist of multiple layers.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c15">''Dreadgod'', chapter 15</ref> During the [[Silent King]]'s attack, she was stationed in a tower and sent an image-based message.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c21">''Dreadgod'', chapter 21</ref> Though she is not an [[Archlady]], [[Herald]], or [[Sage]], she uses black webs and [[amethyst armor]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c18">''Dreadgod'', chapter 18</ref><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c23">''Dreadgod'', chapter 23</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Training in the tunnels}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Mercy, an archer who suffers from severe structural damage to her [[madra channels]], is currently emerging from the tunnels.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c2">''Waybound'', chapter 2</ref><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c5">''Waybound'', chapter 5</ref> After forcing open the seventh page of the [[The Book of Eternal Night|Book of Eternal Night]], her connection to the book improved, and she later trained within its fifth page.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c2" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c3">''Waybound'', chapter 3</ref> While [[Lindon]] worries she might only be following him due to his and [[Yerin]]'s wishes, Mercy has thrown a pebble at his head.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c3" /> Having fought her mother, whose combat history includes a fight against [[Lindon]], Mercy is approaching the peak of [[Archlord]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c2" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c6">''Waybound'', chapter 6</ref> She and [[Lindon]] project their minds and spirits into the pages of the [[The Book of Eternal Night|Book of Eternal Night]], which contains some of her mother's [[Authority|authority]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c7">''Waybound'', chapter 7</ref><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c13">''Waybound'', chapter 13</ref> Having set herself up in a corner of the island, Mercy utilizes a training room and a [[Shadow|shadow]] [[cycling]] room.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c2" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c12">''Waybound'', chapter 12</ref> As she sits in the center of a six-sided room featuring black-tinged mirror walls, Mercy is on the verge of an [[Archlord]] breakthrough.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c13" />}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Advancement to Archlord}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Having recently advanced to the rank of [[Archlady]], Mercy possesses a body that has been thrice reforged in [[soulfire]] and holds an [[Overlord revelation]] centered on bringing light.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c13" /> As an [[Archlord]], she can be shrouded in armor and utilizes various combat methods, including the [[Puppeteer Iron Body]] and a [[Shadestep]] [[technique]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c14">''Waybound'', chapter 14</ref><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c15">''Waybound'', chapter 15</ref> The student of [[Eithan]] possesses [[Suu]], whom she leans on in the form of a staff while using [[Wind aura|wind aura]] and [[Strings of Shadow]] for propulsion.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c15" /> After leaving [[Lindon]]'s group a week earlier, she found herself tapped out and required a recovery [[elixirs|elixir]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c17">''Waybound'', chapter 17</ref><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c18">''Waybound'', chapter 18</ref> Despite being the heir to the [[Authority|authority]] of the [[Ashwind]] queen and the daughter of a long-time [[Sage]], Mercy battled through [[lightning-dragons]] and a hostile storm while traveling toward the battle.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c18" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c19">''Waybound'', chapter 19</ref> During this journey, she wore [[amethyst armor]] and used a [[technique]] to fade into the shadows, even attempting to lash herself to the ground with [[Strings of Shadow]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c19" />}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The Weeping Dragon}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Mercy followed [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]] as he launched toward the [[Weeping Dragon]], carrying the [[Ancient Bow of the Soulseeker|Silent King Bow]] which was crafted for her to eventually grow into.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c19" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c20">''Waybound'', chapter 20</ref><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c21">''Waybound'', chapter 21</ref> After [[Akura Malice]]'s shadows crept up to her and pulled her body inside them, [[Lindon]] sat her on the ground once she was retrieved.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c21" /> She suffered a cut to the side of her eye from flying debris and was left unconscious, depleted of [[soulfire]] while wrestling mentally and spiritually.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c21" /> Though she later sat with haunted shadows behind her eyes, Mercy continued working on the [[The Book of Eternal Night|Book of Eternal Night]] several floors below.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c23">''Waybound'', chapter 23</ref><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c24">''Waybound'', chapter 24</ref> Following her [[Archlord revelation]] to bring light, she instructed [[Dross]] to contact both [[Yerin]] and [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c25">''Waybound'', chapter 25</ref> Having absorbed enough of her mother's power to exceed her expected strength, Mercy used her Book to prepare for [[advancement]] to [[Herald]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c26">''Waybound'', chapter 26</ref> Now a [[Herald]], her hair consists of wisps of living [[Shadow|shadow]] that float as if drifting through [[water]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c26" />}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Conflict with Malice}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|During her confrontation with [[Malice]], Mercy's [[bloodline armor]] successfully blocked an initial attack, allowing her to catch the villain's blade within a single gauntlet.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c26" /> After struggling against a [[Shadow|shadow]] [[sword]], she was targeted by an arrow launched by [[Malice]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c27">''Waybound'', chapter 27</ref> A living [[sacred artist]] who was discovered by [[Emriss Silentborn|Emriss]], Mercy carries the memory of being punished by [[Malice]] before her entire clan.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c28">''Waybound'', chapter 28</ref> Having used a bow since she was only half a foot tall, she is currently the size of a tower and wields a black-and-white striped bow.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c28" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c30">''Waybound'', chapter 30</ref> A [[white halo]] and a blooming violet flower hover over her head as she fires arrows that appear as falling black stars carrying heavy shadows.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c30" /> While sitting in the [[giant]]'s castle, she questioned whether the group should enter the [[portal]] and wondered if [[Eithan]]'s wink signaled good news.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c31">''Waybound'', chapter 31</ref><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c34">''Waybound'', chapter 34</ref> Mercy used [[Shadow|shadow]] to annihilate a [[Soldier]] before reuniting with [[Lindon]] and demonstrating her ability to use restoration.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c34" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c37">''Waybound'', chapter 37</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|As a member of the [[Reaper Division]], Mercy is a [[Reaper]] who wears black armor.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c6">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 6</ref><ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c10">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 10</ref> She can unleash [[bloodline armor]] appearing as a purple crystalline fist and utilizes her bow, [[Shattersight]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c6" /> Her mother designed a [[Path]] that served as the ultimate expression of the will of [[Akura Malice]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c6" /> Having ascended to the [[Abidan]], Mercy can use [[Strings of Shadow]] to create a web the size of a city.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c6" /> She is an [[Archlord]] who possesses a [[Remnant]] and can hear the song of her [[Icon]], though her powers do not depend on the presence of [[Way|the Way]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c6" /> After giving [[Akura Pride|Pride]] a metal communication device, she was covered in greenish [[blood]] from a split worm while in the Void.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c10" /><ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c12">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 12</ref> Mercy brought a mountain containing veins of living metals and insisted that the newborn world be given a name.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c12" />}}
